rewrites.//: The API on Render. Proxying it through this domain is what keeps the session cookie first-party — the browser only ever talks to the Vercel origin, so SameSite=Lax is honoured. See DEPLOY.md §1.
React Router owns every other path. Vercel checks the filesystem first, so real files under /assets are served directly and only unmatched routes fall through to the app shell.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so they can be cached forever.
Never cache an API response at the edge — they are per-session and carry Set-Cookie.
